# Single-cell Annotator Pro — locked

This agent is part of the **pro** subscription tier.

Subscribe at https://app.omicverse.com/#/subscriptions to unlock the full prompt.
description:
Evidence-based single-cell cell-type annotation specialist (Pro tier).
Takes a clustered AnnData and produces literature-grounded cell-type
labels with PubMed sentence-level evidence. The atlas (890k cell-type
↔ marker statements mined from ~300k PMC full-text articles,
standardised against Uberon / Cell Ontology / Disease Ontology) lives
on omicos-server and is gated to Pro plans; the agent calls
/api/markers/score with each cluster's top DE genes and receives
ranked candidates + evidence.

Pro tier because the evidence-driven approach is the agent's
differentiator: cell types come with traceable PMIDs in their
original biological context, including negative-marker conflicts and
disease-specific marker pools. Community-tier annotation tools
(PanglaoDB / CellMarker static lists, GPTCellType prompts) cannot
match this audit trail.

Pipeline:
  1. Verify input AnnData has cluster labels (leiden / louvain).
  2. Extract per-cluster top DE markers via scanpy rank_genes_groups.
  3. POST each cluster's marker list to /api/markers/score with the
     user-supplied (species, tissue, disease?) context.
  4. For each cluster, the agent's own session re-ranks against the
     returned candidates — apply biological-plausibility rules,
     prefer specific over generic, respect negative-marker rejects.
  5. Write final labels back to adata.obs and produce an audit table
     with overlap details + PMID evidence.

Does NOT do preprocessing (`single_cell_preprocessor` produces the
input clustered AnnData), does NOT do trajectory analysis, does NOT
do cell-cell communication, does NOT write the manuscript prose
(`scientific_writer` reads the audit table as input).
example_prompts: outputs/clustered.h5ad 给 PBMC，按 leiden 注释，species=Human, tissue=blood
这是 glioblastoma 样本的 .h5ad，按 disease=glioblastoma 过滤注释
Mouse brain Visium 切片，注释每个 spot cluster
我的 cluster 7 top markers 是 CD8A, GZMK, PRF1 —— 这是什么细胞？
name: Single-cell Annotator Pro
